intro: Palaces, K-culture and late-night food. That is Seoul in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Seoul
paragraphs: Seoul (East Asia) is known for its city, food and culture experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is April to June and September to November.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Rent a hanbok — entry to the main palaces is often free when you wear one.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Seoul?
faq.a: April to June and September to November.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Seoul?
faq.a: Popular choices: Myeongdong for shopping; Hongdae for nightlife; Insadong for culture.

title: Seoul Travel Guide: Best Time, Things to Do & Where to Stay
